reviews.text: The staff and veterinarian were absolutely great. Very straightforward and to the point. The atmosphere is great as well. Ample street parking out front. Brought my feline friend here and she definitely felt at ease as well (albeit she’s easily impressed).

I’m sorry- I’m not the type to write these reviews but let’s be honest. The entire experience here was disappointing. First- the tech cuts me off in the middle of my history then just plugs in “normal” for the notes I received for questions I was never asked. I listed the medications my dog was on and the summary just notes “ joint supplements”. I came merely for a recheck ultrasound and while I admit my dog can be quite wiggly so it wasn’t upsetting they requested she come back on a higher dose of premeds it was concerning for an ultrasound they didn’t shave her stomach at all.  Her exam was over in 5 minutes (really just listened to her while talking to me, so unsure how that was helpful at all) I ended up getting the images done elsewhere and requested a refund. First they acknowledged the request for the imaging. I also asked for the exam since it was so limited. They sent “notes” and told me an exam was done. ( Again- I was in the room.) the exam notes did not align with any actuality for my dog and when i highlighted this I was told the exam notes “auto populated” causing the error and offered the refund of the exam saying it would be in my account in 5-7 business days. After 8 business day I reached out. They told me they hadn’t processed it yet because I didn’t have a card on file and they were working with the processor and management to get me an answer which caused the delay( I then had a solution 45 minutes later) I was told they would make an exception and process my refund over the phone which they asked me to call in yesterday and confirmed I would get a transaction receipt. I followed up today because I had gotten nothing. I got a receipt dated today meaning again it wasn’t processed until I asked for the /third/ time. Overall it’s astonishing the Clincal care was subpar given I clearly acknowledged I was in the field. The only redeeming quality was Dr. Butenkos bedside manner. But the overall experience makes me question how they act with pet parents not so in tune with standards. The office team was also disappointing with follow through poor to say the least.

We are pleased to be regular visitors to this clinic, the best and highest quality service, pleasant surroundings, incredible attitude towards your pet and always quick response to any problem, thank you for being you!

Thank you for taking the time to leave us such a great rating. We truly appreciate the support. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate service and high-quality veterinary care, and it means a lot to know that we made a positive impression.

Everyone at Ukrainian Village Veterinary Center goes above and beyond. The front desk is always so welcoming and patient with my high-strung dog. The doctors and assistants explain everything so clearly and provide us with multiple options for care. Highly recommend!

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Butenko and the entire team. Dr. Butenko has been treating our sweet Jameson with acupuncture, and the results have been incredible. Jameson is truly back to himself—moving, walking, and enjoying life again, which means the world to our family.

Every visit to this clinic has been nothing short of exceptional. The level of care, professionalism, compassion, and knowledge from the veterinarians and staff is truly outstanding. You can genuinely feel how much they care for every animal they treat.

We highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality veterinary care, experienced professionals, and a team you can fully trust with your beloved pets.

Thank you, Dr. Butenko, for giving our Jameson his spark back!
— Maria & Family

We chose this clinic because of its high ratings and proximity to our home in the neighborhood, but after two years and several visits with our three dogs for both routine and urgent care, the experience has been consistently underwhelming.

While the medical staff is friendly, the care feels incredibly rushed and incomplete. On multiple occasions, we’ve walked away with only half of what we came for:

• Incomplete Appointments: During a visit for vaccinations and heartworm prevention, they handled the shots but missed the required heartworm test, forcing further coordination.

• Equipment Limitations: We scheduled a visit specifically for imaging and bloodwork, only to find out upon arrival that their imaging machine wasn't large enough for our dog. We still had to pay the full visit fee before being sent to another clinic to pay another fee elsewhere.

• Communication Gaps: Instructions and prescriptions are often rattled off at "2x speed." Unless you explicitly prompt them to write things down, you leave without a clear plan, and in the rush, small details are frequently missed, leading to avoidable follow-up calls.

The atmosphere at the front desk doesn’t help. The staff there often makes you feel like asking a question or following up is a major hassle. It feels cold and transactional rather than like a partnership in our pets' health.

If you just need a quick, basic stop and live next door, it’s fine—but for anything requiring attention to detail or a supportive environment, the "convenience" isn't worth the extra stress.
I am very grateful to the veterinarians at the clinic. They are true professionals. They treat their patients with kindness and care. We will definitely visit again.

Been going here with my senior great Dane pittie for the last 4 years. Extremely kind and patient staff. My dog has bad anxiety and isn’t always easy to deal with and they stay so sweet and patient with him. Definitely recommend
The team was friendly, the check in process was seamless, there was no wait, and the vet was thorough and helpful. Happy to have a great new vet!

I can’t say enough good things about Ukrainian Village Vet. They completely solved my golden retriever’s ear problems and allergies after we had been struggling for a while. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and you can tell they genuinely care about both pets and owners.

What really stood out was how thorough they were in explaining everything. They took the time to walk me through the diagnosis, treatment options, and next steps in a way that was easy to understand and never rushed. I felt confident and informed the whole time.

If you’re looking for a vet that is knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly invested in your pet’s health, I highly recommend Ukrainian Village Vet.

I was very satisfied with my visit to the clinic. Excellent attitude, attention to detail and professional approach. All questions were explained in detail, the atmosphere is calm and friendly. Thank you very much for the excellent service!

We love Dr. Butenko and all of the staff at this clinic! Dr. Butenko is friendly and you can tell that he really cares about his clients. We can also tell that he loves our pups. We’ve been going here ever since we moved back to Chicago in 2023. He always gets us in if we need an urgent visit, and regular appointments are very easy to schedule as well. He helped up navigate through cancer  with our senior Chihuaua (she beat it and she’s doing great!), and he’s always super helpful if we have a quick question and need to call him. The staff is always friendly and helpful as well. We lucked out by living really close to this clinic and are so happy to have them as our primary vet for our pups!
Fantastic vet! We take our two cats here, everyone there is super friendly, knowledgeable, and patient. Would definitely recommend this vet to others

We absolutely love this clinic! Every time we come, the doctors and staff are so kind, gentle, and truly care about our little Frenchie. Even though it takes us almost an hour to get there, it’s always worth it. They treat our puppy like family and make every visit so easy and comforting. I’m so grateful to have found a place where we feel safe and welcomed every time.
Everyone here is so kind and helpful. My pup even tries to stop by when we’re on a walk in the neighborhood just to say hi.

We have had the best experience bringing our three cats to Ukrainian Village Veterinary Center over the past year. The vet team truly listen to our questions and concerns and give thoughtful answers. Our cats are calm and happy throughout their visits and that is due to the calm nature of the staff and environment.

Excellent clinic, polite staff.
They were understanding about my problem.

Could not recommend this practice more! My dog has a rare condition and they have been wonderful and completely on top of it. I also love that they educate you on various options and paths, versus trying to force something on you. Love this place!

Ukrainian Village Vet is hands down the best vet we have ever taken our dog to, and we have lived in 3 different states. They are incredibly thorough, helpful, and kind. They are always quick to help us get an appointment, and have taken time to explain things to us, and to show us how to do things like carefully cut our pup's nails. I would hands-down recommend this vet to anyone who is looking for good care for their pets :)

I love this practice. Independent. Ukrainian owned. No hedge fund or corporate oversight. Which means higher quality and better prices. But also they really care about the animals. Luckily I've only had wellness and vaccine visits with my current cat. But if anything should happen to her health I would not hesitate to come back here. Support independent local business by bringing your pet here.

I’ve been going to Ukrainian village vet for the last 3 years or so and have really loved my experience. The doctors all take extra care to explain what is going on with my cat, and I have never felt like they are trying to over-sell me on things. The team is super honest, and always willing to give alternate options as needed for treatment options. I’d definitely recommend them!

We brought our dog in for a bee sting allergy issue, and the visit was a complete letdown. The vet refused to refill her heartworm medication without insisting on a blood test to check for heartworms, even though she's been on the medication consistently. If the medicine isn’t effective, why prescribe it in the first place? Our dog was already stressed from the visit, and pushing an unnecessary test made no sense—she shows zero signs of illness. It feels like a money grab with pointless tests and procedures. We won’t be back, and this experience has earned you a bad review. 😕

We had a doctor’s visit today — and I’m honestly so happy.
We also met an amazing doctor.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Andrew  for his calm attitude, thoughtful explanations, and sincere care.
You made everything feel clear and safe — and that means the world.

Special thanks to technician Roman — for being kind, attentive, and making everything easier.
You’re the kind of people who make healthcare feel human again.

I thought for a long time whether to write a review, but still decided that it was necessary! We went to see Dr. Andrew (who, as I see now, is not even listed as an employee on the official website) with an ear problem. He took a swab and said that my dog ​​had an infection and prescribed drops. After 10 days, we came back because the drops did not help, after a second swab it turned out that he already had two infections. The doctor wanted to prescribe other drops and see if his experiment would give results, instead of prescribing an antibiotic and taking a blood test. However, because of my position, he prescribed pills, saying that it was an antibiotic, I read the information about these pills - it is not stated anywhere that it is an antibiotic. When I asked when we should return for a second examination to check if everything is fine and the treatment helped, they told me that it was not necessary, they probably did not like the way I communicated with him. We did everything that was prescribed at home and still the ear was inflamed and red, it was clear that the treatment was not suitable, there must be some other reason. Because of this incorrect treatment we lost time and as a result the dog's condition worsened, the brain was affected and he died. Therefore I do not recommend this clinic, they think how to do an experiment so that you only pay money and come again, and do not look for the real cause of the disease!!!!
We’ve brought our dog here a few times and had a pleasant experience overall.
Great vet & nice people. We’ve taken our pets there for years.
Good spot!

I feel truly blessed to have found this clinic! Before coming here, I took my coughing cat to three different clinics, but none could figure out what was wrong. They ran multiple tests and told me he was completely healthy.

This clinic was completely different—knowledgeable staff who took the time to explain everything to me, no unnecessary tests, and they prescribed the right medication that actually helped. It turned out my cat has asthma, something the other clinics completely missed.

If your pet has similar symptoms, I highly recommend this place. Their expertise made all the difference! 🐾❤️
Dr. Butenko was very nice.  He explained the situation and was very helpful with giving us advice.

I have an elderly pup who always receives the best love and care at Ukrainian Village Vet. I spent a long time searching for the best vet when I moved to Chicago in June and have been extremely satisfied. My dog receives a monthly injection for her arthritis and the staff are always responsive, warm, and compassionate. I am incredibly gracious to have found this practice and would recommend it without hesitation.

I highly recommend Ukrainian Village Veterinary Center. Dr. Butenko is a knowledgeable and compassionate vet who successfully addressed issues in my two cats that a prior vet overlooked.  The staff are skilled and helpful, and the clinic is pristine. Overall a positive experience!
Be careful, they charge unreasonable fees for even the slightest action. It's very sad that pets' health is just a means of profit for some...

Ljubov, we have searched our records and do not have a record of you as a client. Since we don't have you in our records, we can't reach out to address your concerns. If you have a legitimate complaint, please reach out to us at (312) 955-8882 or info@ukrvillagevet.com.
They will charge you for an inspection that is supposedly mandatory, takes 2 minutes, and costs $100.
Super expensive.

Clean and new premises, which is why it's 1 star. I went to this hospital because I was assured that they do tests and examinations before prescribing medication, and not immediately antibiotics like other vets. I was surprised that the doctor was not Danylo, but Andriy, that is, there were several doctors. I came with a cat that had and still has a runny nose and ear inflammation, the cat had dirty eyes and ears so that the same swabs could be taken. After a superficial swab from the ear, nothing but yeast was found, although the cat had a purulent plug deeper in the ear. The assistant said that we would clean the cat's ears, I replied that there was no need for this, I would do it myself, but the cat was returned with half-cleaned ears and $34 was added to my bill. Ear drops were prescribed, which only worsened the situation with the inflammation. After a week of waiting for a visit, and then about 5 days for tests, the doctor said that he found nothing. The following recommendations: either a strong long-term antibiotic (the cat has already undergone 4 courses of antibiotics), or go to another clinic and a more qualified doctor. Waste of time, money ($470), and most importantly the health of the animal.

Got us in quickly and everyone was so kind and really cared! So happy they’re in the neighborhood

2024 Update: Dental cleaning went GREAT! Everyone was so kind and thorough and I felt so reassured my pets were in good hands. The price matched their estimates and they had great advice for how to care for their teeth moving forward.
chose this place due to proximity but was very pleased with the vet!! He was so kind and ensured all my questions were answered. Would recommend.
